description: This header file defines a wrapper interface 'WrapsImpl' with various system call virtual methods, and a singleton-like class 'Wraps' that exposes static methods to interact with that implementation. It is primarily intended for mocking or abstracting system calls for testing purposes.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract class defining virtual methods to wrap system calls for mocking.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: Singleton-like class providing static access to system call wrappers, delegating to an implementation of 'WrapsImpl'.

methods.name: Wraps(const Wraps &obj)
methods.description: Deleted copy constructor to prevent copying.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Static method to set the implementation of WrapsImpl.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to get singleton instance of Wraps.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Static method to execute a system command.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Static method to open a process by creating a pipe.

methods.name: pclose
methods.description: Static method to close the pipe opened by popen.

methods.name: syslog
methods.description: Static method to send a message to the system logger.

methods.name: setmntent
methods.description: Static method to open mntent file.

methods.name: getmntent
methods.description: Static method to read the next mount entry.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Static method for a va_list based version of secure popen.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Static method for a va_list based version of secure pclose.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Static method for a va_list based version of system call.

methods.name: readlink
methods.description: Instance method to read the target of a symlink.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Static method to get current time.
